title: Advisor model (new template)
summary: Choose an action to learn how to start, complete or recover an advisor-prepared application.
audience: Master users, advisors and portal reviewers

start.title: Start a new application
paragraphs: Open the advisor entry and select Start. Enter the advisor email, phone number and code, then choose Log in. The new application begins at Membership.
Use Continue when returning to an application already started.

membership.title: Confirm membership
paragraphs: Complete Membership before continuing. The questions shown come from the selected Site’s configuration.

eligibility.title: Enter eligibility details
paragraphs: Provide the required details for each person applying. The page determines which coverage is available from those answers.

coverage.title: Choose coverage
paragraphs: Select products, covered people and coverage amounts. Review the estimated cost before continuing. Estimates in this prototype are fictional.

beneficiary.title: Add beneficiaries when applicable
paragraphs: Complete beneficiary information when the chosen coverage requires it. This page participates according to the application’s selected products.

contact.title: Enter applicant contact details
paragraphs: Complete the residential address and correspondence details. Include business or dependent contact sections when they are shown.

profile.title: Complete Profile
paragraphs: Complete the required personal, physician and other-coverage details. Profile is the last preparation page before the advisor sends the application.

send.title: Confirm the recipient and send
paragraphs: Choose Next on Profile. Check the applicant name and email in Send to applicant for review, then choose Send. Cancel keeps you on Profile.

sent.title: Check the send confirmation
paragraphs: The confirmation identifies the applicant and shows the sent time and scheduled deletion date. The next part of the walkthrough switches to the applicant.

request-link.title: MFA · Request a secure email link
paragraphs: The applicant enters their saved email. For Advisor Continue, enter the advisor’s own saved email and phone after the applicant email has identified the application. Choose Next to request a separate secure email link; this does not grant access to saved answers.
The public confirmation is the same when no application can be recovered, including after submission or expiry.

open-link.title: MFA · Open the secure link
paragraphs: The confirmation asks you to check the recipient email. Open the secure link to continue to phone verification. If the link expires, request a replacement using the resend action.
The live preview shows the portal confirmation; email delivery is simulated in this prototype.

delivery-method.title: MFA · Choose Text or Call
paragraphs: Choose Text or Call, then Next. The code goes to the saved phone for the person authenticating: applicant phone for applicant access, advisor phone for advisor access. Next consumes the email link and starts MFA; opening the link alone does not.

verify-code.title: MFA · Enter the verification code
paragraphs: Enter the code delivered by the selected phone method and choose Next. A valid code completes verification and restores access.
If the code expires, use Resend code while the verification session is active. If the session expires, restart secure access.
After signing starts, a verified applicant returns to unfinished DocuSign. After submission, recovery stops issuing links; public confirmation remains unchanged.

review.title: Access granted · Review the application
paragraphs: The applicant can now review the advisor-prepared answers. Earlier stages are locked against direct applicant editing.
If everything is correct, complete the required acknowledgements and continue. For a correction, choose an Edit action to request an advisor update.

request-edit.title: Request an advisor correction
paragraphs: This is optional. When the answers are correct, continue from Review without requesting an edit.
Choose an Edit action in the application preview. In Request edit to application, choose Send to confirm, or Cancel to stay on Review.

edit-sent.title: Check the edit-request confirmation
paragraphs: The confirmation identifies the advisor recipient. The advisor contacts the applicant about the changes and reopens the saved application.

continue.title: Find the saved application
paragraphs: On advisor entry, select Continue and enter the applicant email used to begin the application. Choose Log in.

The applicant email identifies the application. The following authentication steps use the advisor’s own email and phone, matched to the saved advisor record; applicant contact details do not authenticate the advisor.

advisor-access.title: Access granted · Reopen the saved answers
paragraphs: Successful verification restores the saved application and returns the advisor to Eligibility. Review the existing answers before making corrections.

update.title: Make the requested changes
paragraphs: Work through the saved application and make the agreed corrections. Review the applicant contact details, then continue through Profile and send it again.

health.title: Complete the required health questions
paragraphs: After reviewing the application, the applicant answers the health questions that apply to the selected products and covered people. The applicable health pages can vary.

payment.title: Complete payment selections
paragraphs: Complete the payment sections shown for the selected products. Available methods and frequencies come from the effective Site configuration.

signature.title: Continue to signature
paragraphs: Continue to the configured signature handoff. This prototype shows the handoff screen; it does not execute a real signature ceremony.
Once signing starts, advisor access ends. Unfinished signing resumes at DocuSign after applicant verification. Completing all required signatures submits the application and opens Receipt.

receipt.title: Read the confirmation receipt
paragraphs: Review the confirmation reference, coverage outcomes and next steps. Use the confirmation reference when discussing the application. Coverage outcomes and rates in this example are fictional.

applicant-invitation.title: Open the application email
paragraphs: The applicant receives an email explaining that the advisor has prepared an application. Choose Continue my application in that email to open Resume.
This invitation link starts access to the application. The applicant then requests a separate secure email link and completes phone verification before seeing any saved answers.

advisor-edit-email.title: Receive the applicant’s edit request
paragraphs: The advisor receives an edit-request email. It identifies the applicant and applicant email, along with the request and application dates.
Use the applicant email shown in the message to locate the application under Continue on advisor entry. Complete secure access before changing the saved answers.

pending-applicant.title: Applicant pending notification
paragraphs: A pending notification reminds the applicant to finish an incomplete application. Use the application link, then complete secure access before continuing.

pending-advisor.title: Advisor pending notification
paragraphs: The advisor’s pending notification identifies the application and applicant email. Reopen it through Continue on advisor entry if follow-up or changes are needed.

deletion.title: Application deletion notification
paragraphs: The deletion notification explains that the incomplete saved application has expired and been deleted. A deleted application cannot be resumed; begin a new application if the applicant still wants to apply.

sections.title: Start an application
sections.description: The advisor prepares an application and sends it to the applicant.

sections.title: Complete an application
sections.description: The applicant opens the advisor’s email, verifies access and completes the application.

sections.title: Revise a saved application
sections.description: Optional correction example: the applicant requests an edit; the advisor verifies access, revises and returns the application. Applicants who need no correction continue directly from Review.

sections.description: Notification types, recipient emails and when each message is sent.

sections.title: Troubleshooting
sections.description: Common questions about application access, technical issues and emails.
